coordinator_instruction: Resolve only the A/B adequacy disagreement or UNCLEAR trigger under the frozen rubric. Do not inspect targets, main/tail role, allocation, rank, path, provenance, historical/local reference, retrieval outcome or metric.

reviewer_A_assessment.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A local public-skill installation workflow preserving package resources and source metadata.
reviewer_A_assessment.rationale: Creates and ports RudderStack transformation libraries, which is a different resource model and does not install the supplied skill unchanged into a local skill library.

reviewer_B_assessment.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A general public-skill installation workflow that copies a source directory and preserves its resources and source metadata in the local skill library.
reviewer_B_assessment.rationale: It manages and can port transformation libraries, but it is confined to RudderStack transformation artifacts and does not install a public skill from the supplied directory into a local skill library.
